content:
maria: Planning Archipelago Dedicated rollout Thu 2026-03-10 02:00-04:00 UTC. Requesting dry-run + approval. Pin: archipelago-dedicated:v2026-03-tilt-rc3. KMS rotation at 09:00 UTC that day.

devon: ack. start with slice-3 dry-run to validate kvcache + weights.

sam: +1. include rollback steps and SLO watchlist.

maria: plan: 1) dry-run slice-3 (no traffic) 2) canary 2% x30m 3) ramp 25% x1h 4) full. rollback: flip route back to stable-slice, scale down fleet, revert pin to v2026-02-stable. SLOs: p99 <220ms, errors <0.5%.

olivia: oncall ack; if p99 >300ms for >5m -> immediate rollback.

maria: /deploy dry-run archipelago-dedicated:v2026-03-tilt-rc3 --slice=slice-3 --check=kvcache,weights,network

deploy-bot: dry-run started...

deploy-bot: output: kvcache OK; weights load OK; WARN gpu-driver mismatch on g-ded-07 (525 expected, 520 found); dry-run completed WITH WARNINGS.

devon: g-ded-07 in slice-3? if yes exclude or replace before canary.

ops-bot: cordoned g-ded-07 and queued replacement ded-replace-24.

deploy-bot: re-run dry-run -> all checks PASSED (gpu-driver 525.4).

sam: add route-pin calls so rollback is a single flip.

maria: yes: POST /admin/route-shift {customer:archipelago, from:stable-slice, to:archipelago-slice-3, percent:2} then ramp.

olivia: KMS rotation window clear (09:00 UTC). I approve once runbook linked.

maria: linked runbook https://rwd.internal/tickets/ARCH-4523/runbook (contains rollback API, SLOs, contacts).

devon: who authorizes emergency rollback during window?

maria: olivia (oncall) + devon (eng-release) must ack in-thread to execute rollback.

olivia: ack.

devon: ack.

sam: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: scheduled job rb-1748888001-archipelago. canary 2026-03-10T02:10Z->02:40Z, ramp start 02:45Z. reminder 30m before.

maria: thanks — will ping 30m prior and post final release notes.

olivia: oncall ready.
